reviews.text: The best dog groomers, friendly staff they really know what they’re doing and understand dogs. One important thing to note is that he’s so relaxed and calm when he’s being groomed at this groomers. Will continue taking him so pleased I found this little gem. Highly recommend.

I was a former student at this grooming school, so when I found myself unable to groom my dog myself, I knew exactly who to trust.

I left my dog in the care of Julie and the team, and they did an amazing job. She looked absolutely beautiful, came home happy, and seeing her so well looked after truly made my day.

A huge thank you to Julie and the whole team for their care, professionalism, and kindness. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them!

Dog Delight did a fantastic job grooming our Scottish Terrier. I mentioned to their attentive staff that he can become stressed if the grooming session takes too long, and they took this on board and planned the appointment accordingly. They did a fabulous job while keeping the session efficient and stress-free for him.

The salon is small but was spotlessly clean when we visited, and the staff were friendly, attentive and professional. I’m very happy with the result and would strongly recommend Dog Delight.
Extremely kind staff. They took great care of my little one, he looks fab💕
A lovely place with a very lovely team!

I had a fantastic experience completing my grooming course here. Julie, Patsy, and the whole team were incredibly supportive, patient, and encouraging throughout, creating a welcoming environment that helped me build both my skills and confidence. I couldn't have asked for a better place to learn and would highly recommend it to anyone considering a career in dog grooming.

What an incredible bunch of girls ♥️
I completed my L2&3 City & Guilds Dog Grooming Diploma with them back in October and the whole team was just amazing.
No question was too much, they were so incredibly supportive throughout my training and have continued to be afterwards aswell, the talent and knowledge combined these girls have is amazing and they were all so welcoming and made me not want to leave!
The course itself is very hands on practically which I loved, you will be grooming two dogs a day from start to finish everyday while you’re there and the team really make sure you get the most out of those practical days. The tutor to student ratio is near on 1-1 especially with the apprentices in there who are equally as knowledgeable as the tutors, and if you ever need support they’re all there to jump in and help you…again no question is too much!
It’s also incredibly flexible, you can do as little as one day a week to five days a week with no pressure to do anymore or any less than what you can commit to!
I would highly recommend this course to anyone wanting to start a career in dog grooming!!

Julie, Patsy, Katie, Shannon, Abbie, Dakota & Beth…. Thank you ♥️

I had the privilege of training at Dogs Delight last year, between September and December and everyone on the team is absolutely incredible! So friendly and knowledgeable, they really made learning so fun and engaging! Thank you so much, Dogs Delight - I’m so glad I found you!! 🙏🏻🙏🏻 …

Really excellent hand stripping - they are probably the best place in London if you wish to achieve breed standard. Not a reflection on the staff at all, but its worth noting that the management/ownership are consistently incompetent and rude.

We've been bringing Toby to Dogs Delight for his grooming for a while now and wouldn't go anywhere else. The whole team are friendly, welcoming and clearly care about the dogs they look after.

Toby always comes back looking fantastic, smelling lovely and, most importantly, happy and relaxed. They always take the time to listen to exactly how we'd like him groomed and the results are consistently excellent.

The salon is clean, professional and it's obvious the staff are experienced and genuinely love what they do. We have complete confidence leaving Toby in their care and would highly recommend Dogs Delight to anyone looking for a reliable, caring and skilled grooming salon.

Thank you to everyone at Dogs Delight for always taking such great care of Toby! Xx
